freeze.applyingWiresRequires: immunecity repo session or explicit user override of freeze

notes: Prefer committed Discovery copies for GitHub raw — dist/outputs is gitignored.
Replace {ref} with main or a commit SHA.
Replace {fileName} with artifact basename from consume contract artifacts[].fileName.
Publish bundle requires bun run outputs locally or a hosted mirror.

loadOrder: 1. MANIFEST.json or discovery catalogue.json — verify notCds / autoApproveIntoKg=false / partnerSigned=false
3. required_pilot: partner lock + vertical + pilot pack/rubric/acceptance/walkthrough + flip-readiness + consume contract + wiring spec
4. recommended_secondary: gap / R2 / SSc / gut / neuro / translation / systems vision / licensing stub
5. optional_proposal: embedding / eval / genome / P3 matrix / adapter proposals

established.label: Established
established.desc: Human-supported claim with durable provenance; safe to surface under HITL / discovery constraints.

uncertain.label: Uncertain
uncertain.desc: Partial support, conflict, or source-linked but not claim-assessed — label honesty required.

unexplored.label: Unexplored
unexplored.desc: Draft, unreviewed, or no mapped source — discovery only; never CDS-actionable.

orthogonalAxes: hsiGrade — coarse band only; not Gate C; not confidence score
teachingStatus — separate KG label; never merge axes into one score
hardBans: Model proposals / embeddings / MD / generative drafts must never flip hsiGrade
Packs remain evidence authority over proposal shelves
Never surface grades as clinical actions

rules: Publish leaves every evidence-backed Gate C row as pending
Approve+supports is human-only in ISI product Neon — never automated from hsi-core
HSI db:gate-c-local may upsert pending placeholders into red-wave only
Same PMID on multiple axes requires curator S-P-O re-check before approve

immunecitySuggested.HSI_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL: Raw discovery base or CDN mirror of publish bundle
immunecitySuggested.HSI_GIT_SHA_OR_REF: Pin main tip or commit SHA
immunecitySuggested.ISI_DATABASE_URL: autumn-snow product only — never red-wave for Gate C approve

hsi.name: human super intelligence
hsi.role: HSI substrate + pending Gate C placeholders only

isi.name: immunecity
isi.role: ISI product DB + human Gate C approve+supports

acceptanceTests.assert: index or contract has notCds=true, autoApproveIntoKg=false, partnerSigned=false
vertical.activeScope==='ra-tnf'; secondary packs do not replace ASK
ISI Gate C approve config must not target red-wave; HSI migrations must not target autumn-snow
bun test test/isiConsumerWiring.test.ts && bun run examples/isi-consumer/demo.ts

honesty: This spec is an out-of-repo wiring handoff — does not edit immunecity.
partnerSigned remains false until a named partner confirms in writing.
Applying product wires requires an immunecity session or user freeze override.
